# File Intelligence

Flagship GigAI experiences that work out what your file is and what to do with it: starting with hitting an exact size.

3 tools. Each name opens the tool on gigai.tools, where its page explains how to use it step by step.

| Tool | What it does | Input | Output | Runs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [GigAI Fit](https://gigai.tools/gigai-fit) | Make any file fit. | JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, PDF, MP4, MOV, WebM, MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC | JPG, PDF, MP4, MP3 | Browser |
| [GigAI IconLab](https://gigai.tools/icon-lab) | Start with one icon. Create an entire family. | SVG, JSON | SVG, PNG, React, Vue, Sprite, JSON, TypeScript, ZIP | Browser and backend |
| [GigAI Verify](https://gigai.tools/gigai-verify) | AI or human? Analyze the evidence. | JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF, MP4, MP3, WAV, TXT, MD, Pasted text | JSON report, Copied summary | Browser |

## Where the backend comes in

- **GigAI IconLab**: The optional AI composer runs on the backend. Building and exporting icons stays in the browser.
